Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: New: the Synastry Wizard (button in the header, the menu, the mini player, or /syn wizard). Pick an animation everyone has (or send it), pick roles, line up, and ready together. One person can choose for the room; the others ready with one click or ask to swap.
